column1: # Estate-owned launchd jobs that are deliberately NOT running, and why.
# verify_estate.sh grades jobs by reading `launchctl list`, which only lists LOADED jobs and
# only surfaces a nonzero exit code. A job that is disabled in launchctl's override database,
# or that was never bootstrapped, has no row and no exit code, so it is graded by nothing.
# That is how com.prospector.offsite-backup stopped on 2026-08-17 and went unnoticed for two
# days while the probe reported the rest of the estate accurately.
# The fix cannot be "fail on every job that is off", because several are off on purpose and a
# check that is permanently red is a check nobody reads. So being off is allowed here, with a
# reason, and anything off WITHOUT a line here is a failure.
# Format: label<TAB>reason. A line with no reason is not accepted.
